name: BUA Questionnaire Prompt Retriever
description: Retrieves stage-specific conversational instructions for the LLM. The conversation's pruposeis to have the user give info about the BUA's information in a structured way, and this function provides the LLM with the appropriate instructions to ask the user for the right information at each stage.

inputs.name: stage
inputs.description: The current stage of the interview ('start', 'lab_identity', 'strains', 'personnel').
